sections.h2: 1. Keep the total at $50 or more
parts: Free standard shipping needs $50 or more paid after any discount. A $39.99 WK61 V2 doesn't reach it, so you'd pay $5.99 to ship to the US. Adding a box of switches or keycaps can tip the order over $50.

Most keyboards were on sale on womierkeyboard.com when we checked, such as the SK61 HE at $89.99 instead of $128.99. One Trustpilot reviewer advises against third-party sellers, and warranty claims are simpler with a receipt from the brand's store.

sections.h2: 3. Pick wired if you don't need wireless
parts: The wired WK61 V2 was $39.99 against $64.99 for the wireless Q61 Pro, both 60% layouts. If the keyboard will stay on one desk, wired is the cheaper choice.
In-stock items ship within 2 to 3 business days. Standard shipping takes 8 to 15 business days, and DHL Express (3 to 7 days) costs $19.99 or more extra in some countries.

For a change of mind, ask for a return within 7 days of delivery; the keyboard must be unused and in its original packaging, and you pay return postage. Faulty or wrong items reported within 7 days are replaced or refunded, and a 1-year limited warranty covers defects after that.
